_comment: Chat Bridge v3 mock-mode fixtures (owner D, contract V3). Used with --mock so the renderer is fully testable phone-free. people mirrors the exact eng:people result shape, messages mirrors the exact eng:messages result shape. ts values are epoch seconds, same unit the engine getMessages returns. Only fix_chat_marc carries messages; other fixture chats return empty lists so the renderer exercises the empty state. Echo-send semantics: eng:send in mock mode resolves {ok: true, error: null} after 800 ms and appends the sent text to that chat as a new fromMe message (id fix_echo_<epoch>, ts = send time in epoch seconds, kind text), so the round trip renders without a phone. Zero network, zero real WhatsApp.

fix_chat_marc.text: Messages and calls are end-to-end encrypted. Only people in this chat can read them.
